summary: Inventory plugins generate dynamic inventory from external systems; source_vars can carry plugin configuration for EC2, GCE, Azure RM, vCenter, ESXi, Satellite 6, Red Hat Lightspeed, OpenStack, RHV, AAP, Terraform State and OpenShift Virtualization, with templates keeping legacy output.
